heroTitle: I design brands & digital products, and build web & mobile app experiences that bring them to life.
heroDescription: Over ten years across design and technology, connecting thoughtful UX with responsive web development and mobile app experiences.
aboutLead: I design and build digital products and brands that help people understand a business, trust what it offers, and know what to do next. My work connects UI/UX and brand design with web and mobile app development using JavaScript, TypeScript, React, React Native, Angular, Next.js, and Vue.js. I build responsive web interfaces, mobile app screens, reusable components, and design systems, with attention to accessibility and performance. I also work across motion design and video editing, manage projects and guide products from concept to launch, connecting the creative work with the decisions and delivery needed to make it real.
toolkitDescription: From web and mobile interface design to working products: reusable components, state management, API integration, and responsive styling.
aboutStory: Being a father has made me more intentional about what I build and the impact it has on people. I bring that same care to product and brand design, product engineering, motion design, and video editing, while managing projects across IT, creative, construction, and operations.
